# [TASK] Build media attachment uploaders and thumbnail galleries for movie reviews

## Task
Add file attachment capabilities to movie review submission forms in the React frontend, allowing users to upload screenshot proofs or short clips and rendering interactive thumbnail galleries on movie detail pages.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Review comment form includes an attachment uploader supporting image and short video files (`ReviewMediaSection.test.jsx`: `displays validation error when attempting to attach an unsupported file format`, `displays validation error when file exceeds 20MB limit`)
- [x] Media assets upload via `POST /api/v1/media/upload` with `entityType=MOVIE_REVIEW` and `entityId` linking the movie/review (`ReviewMediaSection.test.jsx`: `successfully uploads media attachment with entityType=MOVIE_REVIEW upon form submission`)
- [x] Movie details page retrieves associated review media via `GET /api/v1/media/entity/{entityId}` and renders clickable thumbnail galleries (`ReviewMediaSection.jsx` `useGetMediaForEntityQuery`; `ReviewMediaSection.test.jsx`: `renders thumbnail gallery and opens interactive lightbox modal upon click`)
- [x] Unit/DOM tests verify attachment uploads and gallery rendering (`npx vitest run src/components/MovieInformation/ReviewMediaSection.test.jsx src/components/MovieInformation/MovieInformation.test.jsx`, 15 tests)

## Estimate
Hours: 12

## Notes
Verified via Vitest tests in `ReviewMediaSection.test.jsx` and `MovieInformation.test.jsx` (15/15 passing this run).
